title: CI exact checkout provenance and Production source-head classification

phases.objective: Bind Recovery test progress artifacts to the exact Git tree actually checked out, classify Production promotion candidates from the pull-request source-head SHA instead of GitHub's synthetic merge SHA, and cancel only superseded pull-request CI runs while push and workflow-dispatch verification remain non-cancellable.

e2e_journeys.actor: CI evidence publisher and repository reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: CI and CI Pull Request Recovery concurrency plus the Production Context Kernel scope and Recovery Unit & Integration Tests jobs
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Recovery evidence is bound to the exact checked-out candidate, canonical CI retains synthetic merge testing while its Production classifier and ratchet diff use the validated pull-request source-head SHA, and newer pull-request synchronization cancels obsolete PR runs without making push or workflow-dispatch runs cancellable.
steps: Checkout the selected pull-request head SHA or explicit workflow-dispatch SHA in Recovery.
Resolve git rev-parse HEAD immediately before the Recovery test suite.
Reject any mismatch between the Recovery checkout and selected candidate SHA.
Run npm test with process-local GITHUB_SHA bound to the verified Recovery checkout SHA.
Keep canonical CI tests on GitHub's merge checkout while reading pull_request.head.sha as the only Production candidate identity.
Reject a missing, malformed, or unavailable Production source-head commit before classification.
Run the Production promotion classifier and Context Kernel diff against the validated source-head SHA rather than the synthetic merge SHA.
Use the pull-request event predicate as the only cancel-in-progress authority for CI and Recovery.
Keep push and workflow-dispatch verification outside cancellation authority.
Use the registered currentness probe only to activate read-only generated-artifact evaluation and governed Recovery delegation.
Upload ordered test progress reports without relabeling head execution as a different merge candidate.
assertions: Recovery reports cannot inherit a different event-level GITHUB_SHA after exact-head checkout.
A Recovery candidate identity mismatch fails before npm test.
The canonical Production classifier never receives the synthetic pull-request merge SHA as candidate identity.
The Context Kernel changed-file set for a Production promotion is computed from the classifier-selected phase base to the validated source-head SHA.
A missing, malformed, or unavailable Production source-head SHA fails closed.
Superseded pull-request runs are cancellable in both CI workflows.
Push and workflow-dispatch runs are not unconditionally cancellable.
The currentness probe grants no repository-content write authority.
No repository write, protected-ref mutation, provider call, deployment, database action, migration, credential access, or external send is introduced.
The Recovery workflow retains read-only contents permission.

phases.objective: Publish the verified checkout and source-head identities plus superseded-run cancellation reason as explicit typed fields across all CI evidence families.
Prove identity preservation and current-head selection across reruns, workflow dispatch, pull-request synchronize events, synthetic merge changes, and cancelled or restarted jobs.
This CI evidence and scheduling correction has no provider canary authority.
This CI evidence and scheduling correction grants no Production or deployment authority.
